authority_rule: Planning sequence only. Live selection and implementation authority come exclusively from operations/CURRENT.json and its referenced MVPS checkpoint.

MVPS-01.title: Canonical Species Aggregate and Invariants
MVPS-01.goal: Define SpeciesDefinition, CharacterSpeciesSelection, identity/version/provenance, authored-vs-granted boundaries, lifecycle states, extension policy and executable-vs-descriptive separation.
acceptance: no species-specific runtime engine is introduced

MVPS-02.title: Choice Schema and Character-Creation Transaction
MVPS-02.goal: Define fixed grants, selectable groups, budgets/counts, alternatives, substitutions, exclusions, campaign gates, unresolved choices and creation-stage validation.
acceptance: draft can remain incomplete without being playable

MVPS-03.title: Morphology and Body-Plan Contract
MVPS-03.goal: Normalize size-independent anatomy, limbs/manipulators, worn regions, attachment points, natural appendages and unusual body plans.
acceptance: humanoid and non-humanoid fixtures use one morphology interface
inventory/equipment can query body compatibility without species-name branching

MVPS-04.title: Scale, Movement and Sense Capability Integration
MVPS-04.goal: Connect scale profiles, locomotion modes and senses to shared capability/rules profiles.
acceptance: movement and senses are typed grants
derived values reference shared rules profiles

MVPS-05.title: Physiology, Lifecycle and Environmental Tolerance
MVPS-05.goal: Separate descriptive biology from executable respiration, sustenance, rest, aging/lifecycle, temperature/pressure/gravity/radiation/water/vacuum and other tolerance hooks.
acceptance: descriptive fields cannot silently mutate mechanics

MVPS-06.title: Capability Grants and Natural Equipment
MVPS-06.goal: Normalize species-granted abilities, actions/reactions, resources, resistances/immunities, proficiencies, natural weapons/armor/organs and other typed capabilities.
acceptance: every executable grant has canonical identity and provenance
natural equipment resolves through shared item/ability/effect contracts

MVPS-07.title: Equipment, Vehicle and Interface Compatibility
MVPS-07.goal: Define compatibility predicates for clothing, armor, weapons, tools, implants, seats, mounts, vehicles, suits and body slots.
acceptance: compatibility is not inferred only from size
common interface handles diverse body plans

MVPS-08.title: Lineage/Subspecies Inheritance and Composition
MVPS-08.goal: Define deterministic parent/lineage deltas, overrides, exclusions, grant stacking and composition order.
acceptance: lineages do not copy full parent records
conflicts are surfaced rather than guessed

MVPS-09.title: Forms and Transformation Semantics
MVPS-09.goal: Separate species from form and define changes/retention across anatomy, scale, movement, senses, equipment, attributes, grants, resources and presentation.

MVPS-10.title: Species Progression and Maturation Hooks
MVPS-10.goal: Permit optional species progression, maturation and unlock trees through the existing progression-event model.

MVPS-11.title: Social, Language and Knowledge Identity Hooks
MVPS-11.goal: Connect species identity to reputation/relationship/law/faction/knowledge systems without encoding culture or behavioral stereotypes as biology.
acceptance: biological communication and learned languages are distinct
observer knowledge can hide canonical identity

MVPS-12.title: Validation, Migration and Import/Export
MVPS-12.goal: Define structural/behavioral/integration validators, playable/incomplete/invalid/migration-required states, version migration and historical-choice preservation.
acceptance: missing canon is never silently fabricated

MVPS-13.title: Runtime Projection and Grant Receipts
MVPS-13.goal: Produce a deterministic current species contribution from base species + lineage + form + adaptations + campaign adjudications.
acceptance: temporary state does not corrupt base selection

MVPS-14.title: Authoring, Search, Inspection and Presentation
MVPS-14.goal: Implement species authoring/reference surfaces, builder projection, GM inspector, cross-links, assets and permission-aware presentation.
acceptance: UI is projection not rules authority

MVPS-15.title: NPC/Creature Reuse and Cross-System Adapters
MVPS-15.goal: Prove player species can be consumed by NPC/creature/campaign/combat/social/exploration/crafting systems without collapsing species, creature definition, archetype and instance.

MVPS-16.title: Radical-Species Conformance and Golden Proof
MVPS-16.goal: Run the common contract against eight radically different species fixtures and close all remaining semantic gaps.
acceptance: all eight fixtures pass the common conformance matrix
no species-name conditional is needed for core workflows
